exactFiniteProductDeclaration: theorem Finset.prod_ite {s : Finset ι} {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (f g : ι → M) : ∏ x ∈ s, (if p x then f x else g x) = (∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s with ¬p x, g x
scope: variable {ι M γ : Type*} {s : Finset ι}; namespace Finset; section CommMonoid; variable [CommMonoid M]. The later Fintype section is separate.
